name: build an mpi distributed variant runnable under mpirun
definition: parallelize the simulation across ranks with MPI message passing, compile it, and ensure it can start via the mpi launcher.
failure_mode: an mpi binary that does not run properly under the multi-rank launcher fails the output checks

name: build an R notebook that loads data and a DAG specification
definition: Create a legacy-nbformat notebook whose R kernel metadata is set and whose cells load the data file and the DAG description.
failure_mode: Notebook invalid, wrong kernel, empty, or no loading code.
